text:
Maria (partnerships): Heads up — one of the containers from Orion that was supposed to fulfill part of our Dedicated EU reserves got split at the port. Half released, half under hold. Customer-facing risk for next-week commitments.
Tom (logistics): Ugh. Which container and BL? Any hold reason?
Maria (partnerships): BL: ORN-EU-00987. Port listed 'terminal detention' + chassis shortage. Orion says hold until chassis available.
Maria (partnerships): Manifest snippet:
```
ORN-EU-00987 | 20x A100-80GB | reserved-EU-q3 | ETA 2026-03-25 | status: split/hold
ORN-EU-00988 | 10x A100-80GB | reserved-EU-q3 | ETA 2026-03-25 | status: released
```
Tom (logistics): Can you forward the vendor hold notice? I want the exact PO/eta they cite. If detention fees start, we need to contest with carrier or supplier.
Orion (supplier): @maria @tom we're investigating. Port flagged chassis allocation — a downstream yard hasn't turned units. We're asking for priority devanning but that can cost demurrage. We will escalate and push for wave swap but need a signed reallocation to move 20 units to a later vessel.
Leila (ops): What's the customer impact window? Which committed accounts will be short?
Maria (partnerships): Two Dedicated customers: acme-edge (50 GPU commit, expecting 20 from this shipment) and flux-analytics (short 8 GPUs). Acme has a launch on 2026-03-30 — they can't slip.
Andrew (sales): If acme loses 20, we blow the launch. Can we borrow from our APAC reservoir for 2 weeks and backfill after the chassis clears? Routing time to EU via air is ~72h once available.
Suzanne (finance): Air move + vendor priority will add costs. We need estimates before approving. Also dispute detention charges if they're carrier fault. Please get invoicing evidence.
Manifest-bot: Carrier update -> https://tracking.example.com/ORN-EU-00987 status=detained at Port-AMS. ETA update pending.
Tom (logistics): Carrier paperwork attached in DM. Looks like chassis shortage triggered shift; detention charges start day+3. We should push supplier to absorb day+3 to day+10 while we escalate.
Orion (supplier): We can credit detention day+3 to day+7 but not beyond without supplier OBL paperwork. We'll cover detention up to $4k/day for the 20 units in question. We can also offer a one-time credit for processing.
Leila (ops): Ok, two parallel asks: 1) approve APAC->EU temporary swap of 20 GPUs to cover acme. 2) ask Orion to issue credit for detention and extra handling.
Andrew (sales): I'll notify acme with a careful comms draft offering temporary routing + a 10% service credit if we miss SLA. Need ops confirmation.
Suzanne (finance): If Orion covers up to $4k/day, total worst-case for 7 days is $28k + airmove ~ $12k = ~$40k. That's approvable under contingency but flag to CFO. Request formal credit memo from Orion.
Orion (supplier): Will produce credit memo for detention and handling. For the APAC swap, we need a signed temporary reallocation form and updated reservation IDs.
Maria (partnerships): I'll draft the reallocation form and circulate. Action items: Maria to post reallocation form; Tom to confirm fastest routing/time for APAC units; Leila to schedule capacity handover in the console (reserve changes); Suzanne to prepare contingency charge approval; Andrew to pre-draft customer message.
Tom (logistics): If we air-move, we should code shipments with expedited customs pre-clear to shave 12-18h. I can coordinate with customs broker.
Leila (ops): I'll create a limited-time reservation mapping: move 20 GPUs from reserved-APAC-q2 -> reserved-EU-temporary-2026-03-25 (2 week window). Need manifest numbers.
Maria (partnerships): Draft reallocation form posted: https://docs.example.com/realloc-ORN-EU-00987 (please sign).
Andrew (sales): I'll hold off ACME comms until Tom confirms ETA. Thanks — will stand by. :thumbsup:
Suzanne (finance): Please attach the Orion credit memo before we finalize approvals.
Orion (supplier): Credit memo placeholder uploaded to vendor portal. Will send signed copy in 2h.
Maria (partnerships): Solid plan. Quick note: we also want a retro log for this incident to feed procurement lead-time modeling. Leila — can you add a short postmortem after closure?
Leila (ops): Yep — will do a 1-page note with timeline and recommendation (add 10% buffer to EU commit for 60 days).
Manifest-bot: Auto-reminder scheduled: follow-up in 48h for status update on ORN-EU-00987.
Maria (partnerships): Great. Closing thread for now — we'll update when credit memo and signed reallocation are in. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
